faq.title: Straight answers
faq.q1: Does JobFinder make things up on my resume?
faq.a1: No — and that's the whole point. A code-enforced Fabrication Guard diffs every tailored claim against a ledger built from your original resume. Anything it can't trace back to your real experience is flagged, not shipped.
faq.q2: Will the output pass ATS screening?
faq.a2: Yes. Both the DOCX and PDF exporters enforce ATS-safe rules: single column, standard section names, no tables, text boxes, images, headers, or footers — just clean, parseable text.
faq.q3: Do I need an account or a subscription?
faq.a3: No accounts, no billing. It's a personal tool. It even runs fully offline with a built-in stub, so you can try the entire pipeline without an API key.
faq.q4: How is this different from auto-apply tools?
faq.a4: Auto-apply tools optimize for volume and often submit generic, fabricated applications that get flagged. JobFinder optimizes for quality and truth: you stay in control of what's sent, and every claim is defensible.
